GPT 5.5 Changes Everything

I asked OpenAI Codex to build a full Mac app while I slept. No code. No dev team. No late-night debugging. Just one prompt, one goal, and an AI coding agent that kept moving until the job was done.

With GPT 5.5, Codex, AI agents, Claude Opus 4.7, and automation racing ahead, the question is not who has better prompts. It is who lets AI execute first. Watch till the end before you call this hype.
